title: Kyber 0.28 don land
author: Jean-Baptiste Kempf
quote: Our version 0.28 don comot, and e carry 3 big updates: Mac fit be host now, click don dey land correct, and new encode engine don join.
html:
Kyber 0.28 don land!

Kyber 0.28 don comot.

Now Mac fit be host, no be only client again. Apart from dat one: clicks no go dey land for where you no aim again, log files don change house and you fit finally turn dem up or down, you go get straight ansa to “which version I dey run?”, plus one new capture engine wey you fit try if e sweet you.

See di main tins wey dey inside.

Kyber dey stream macOS now (alpha version)

Mac don always fit connect to Kyber host. For 0.28, Mac fit be host imsef, but na only for developers wey sabi di work well-well.

Di installation wizard never ready, so di app dey inside ordinary zip file. You go need launch di app by yourself through command line (check GitLab for di documentation) — no window wey you go leave open, and nothing wey you go dey launch with hand.

For capture, e dey use Apple ScreenCaptureKit, wey dey pick di screen and di system sound togeda, and encoding dey run for di Mac own hardware through VideoToolbox. Di system dey choose di two by imsef, so you no need touch any configuration file at all to get Mac host wey dey work. You need macOS 13 Ventura or di ones wey come after am for audio capture, and di builds dey only for Apple Silicon.

Two tins go need your attention di first time. macOS go ask you for Screen Recording and Accessibility permission, and if you no give am, you go see black screen, or input no go work, or both go happen. Dem also sign di build ad hoc instead of with Developer ID, so Gatekeeper go dey complain di first time wey you launch am.

Dis na di first release and e dey show for some places. Mac host dey forward only keyboard and mouse — no gamepad, no clipboard sharing, no remote cursor shape for now — and di watermark overlay no dey available.

Clicks go dey stay on top di video

When di video no full di whole window — black bars wey come from different aspect ratio, session wey dey inside window, or client wey you don resize — clicks wey land for di black border still dey go di remote machine. You fit click sometin for di host wey you no even aim.

Now, na only click wey really land for di video Kyber go forward. If you start drag for di video, di release go still reach, so nothing go hook down for di oda side, and scroll wheel still dey work anywhere inside di window.

Which version I dey run?

Na correct question, but before-before e dey hard well-well to ansa am, because release builds dey either show empty revision or one 0.1.0 wey no mean anytin.

kyclient --version dey now and e dey print di real build. Di revision line for di startup log no dey empty again. And for Windows, di tray menu dey show di build for top, above Restart and Stop.

Di tray don also stop to dey exaggerate. Before, e go quick change to “connected” di moment wey client log in through HTTP, and e go remain like dat even if di client no fit start to stream; now e dey wait for real session. Di tray icon na di new Kyber logo, and na di same tin for di desktop client own icon wey dey your dock and taskbar.

New capture and encode engine wey go open road for future improvement

Na on top txproto dem build Kyber capture and encoding. 0.28 come with second engine wey dem build direct on top FFmpeg and compile inside di same binary, and you fit choose am as e dey run with backend = "libavconv" for kyber_config.toml .

txproto still be di default and di fallback. Di new engine don already cover screen capture, audio, watermarking, bitrate and keyframe control and RTP for Windows and Linux; e no dey for macOS. See am as preview — di whole reason wey we ship di two na say if wahala show for di new one, na just small configuration change you go do to dodge am, no be say you go redeploy everytin.

Small-small tins wey dey add up

encoder for inside kyber_config.toml no be by force again. If you no put am, Kyber go choose correct hardware encoder for di platform: VideoToolbox for Mac, NVENC for oda places. Before, if `encoder` line no dey, di capture server no go even start at all, and dat one make configuration file wey person trim by hand turn trap.

Di Download logs button for di web client now dey give you complete metrics file anytime during live session. Before, di browser dey only write dat file for real when di stream close, so if you download am for middle of session, you go get one wey cut for half and you go need disconnect before you fit get your data. Now dem dey batch di metrics instead of to write dem one by one, so session wey dey produce thousands of samples every second no go dey drop dem for ground again.

If you dey use gopstream video transport, Kyber go off intra-refresh for you as you select am. Di two no fit work togeda — intra-refresh dey remove di keyframes wey dey come from time to time, wey gopstream dey use mark boundary — and before, if you combine dem, gopstream go quietly fall back to ordinary reliable behaviour but e still dey pay di overhead. With one header fix for di same release, gopstream dey do wetin e talk for di first time.

Logs don change house

Dis one worth make you read am even if you skip di rest.

Before, every Kyber component dey write im log near im own executable. Now di logs dey go where each operating system dey expect dem:

  • Windows services: %ProgramData%\Kyber\logs
  • Windows desktop client: %LOCALAPPDATA%\Kyber\logs
  • macOS: ~/Library/Logs/Kyber , so Console.app go fit find dem
  • Linux: ~/.local/state/kyber/logs

If you get support runbook, log collection script or monitoring rule wey point to di old location, e go just quietly find nothing now. KYBER_LOG_DIR still dey override all dis one.

To balance am, you fit finally adjust verbosity without rebuild. --log-level flag dey, KYBER_LOG_LEVEL variable dey, and log_level keys dey for kyber_config.toml — even per component, so you fit turn one noisy part of di stack up reach trace without say every oda tin go drown you. KYBER_VLC_VERBOSE dey work well now too; before, e dey on di log channel but e no dey ever tell VLC make e talk true-true.

One tin wey no change: log files still dey grow without limit. Rotation no dey dis release.

Fixes wey make tins steady

kyclient : Plenty ways wey di desktop client fit take fall don clear. E no dey panic again when dem drop im runtime for wrong time, e no dey abort again when server report value wey pass range, e no dey throw away important events like Connected again when one internal queue full, and e no dey leak metrics task again, di one wey dey release old numbers every five seconds after you don disconnect.

kymedia : For Wayland hosts, Kyber dey find display geometry well now instead of to guess am. For Windows, di side channel of di remote cursor dey try connect again instead of to give up for di first try — before, startup race fit make you lose hardware cursor for di whole session. For Linux DRM/KMS capture, if graphics card fail to initialise, Kyber go report am once per device instead of every poll, and dis one go stop multi-GPU hosts from filling dia logs with di same line thousands of times.

kymux : Send and receive operations for di transport layer dey cancel-safe now, so if connection scatter for middle of write, e no fit leave half-written packet behind. Message wey Kyber no recognise no dey kill di connection again. And when video or audio arrive in pieces across plenty UDP packets, to join am back now dey allocate once for di correct size instead of to dey grow buffer again and again.

kynput : If you pass null pointer give di C API, e no go do anytin instead of to cause undefined behaviour, and dis one close two real crash paths.

Tori for integrators and administrators

Two changes need make you take action if dem concern you.

If you embed Kyber through im C API, dis release go break some tins. Now dem dey generate type names with consistent prefix, and dis one rename some of dem:

  • Position → kynput_Position
  • Size → kynput_Size
  • UnicodeInput ` → kynput_UnicodeInput
  • VideoLayout → kynput_VideoLayout
  • kyclient_metrics_cb → kyclient_MetricsCb
  • kyclient_metrics_json_producer → kyclient_MetricsJsonProducer
  • kyclient_metrics_json → kyclient_MetricsJson

kyclient_event_get_type dey take reference now too. Nothing else change for di headers, so na just to dey rename dem one by one.

For Linux hosts, if your ` [kyavserver] ` section no get ` grab_backend ` line, 0.28 go settle on ` nvfbc ` where 0.27 leave di choice open. Hosts wey no be NVIDIA suppose set am clear now — ` drm `, ` xcb ` or ` wlroots `. Dem no rename di setting imsef.

Di macOS download file names don change too, and new server download dey near di client one, so anytin wey you script against di old names, make you check am well.

Upgrade

Kyber 0.28 dey available now.

Go di downloads page make you get di latest version, or pull di updated packages through di channel wey you dey always use.

We dey welcome your feedback and bug report for our Discord .
